description: Find publications or grants with similar research topics based on abstract/description text. Uses Dimensions concept extraction and weighted concepts search (not vector embeddings). Prefer this over execute_dsl for similarity. For a known record: get_by_id / get_by_doi first, then pass its abstract/description as text. Supported entityType: publications, grants only.

confirmLargeFetch.description: Required when skip≥5000, page≥5, or limit=1000 with skip>0. See dimensions://schema/policy.

entityType.description: Entity type to search (publications or grants)

fields.description: Fields to return. Accepts aliases or DSL names. Use dimensions://fields/{entity} for the full list.

page.description: Page index (0-based). Equivalent to skip = page × limit. Max page 49.

skip.description: Records to skip (0-based). Mutually exclusive with page. Max window: 50000 total records.

sortBy.description: Sort field (default: score for relevance). Examples: score, times_cited, year, start_year.

text.description: Abstract, description, or other prose to find similar documents for. Longer topical text works better than short keywords.

yearFrom.description: Filter from this year inclusive (publications: year; grants: start_year)

yearTo.description: Filter up to this year inclusive (publications: year; grants: start_year)

name: similar_documents

largeResultWarning.description: Soft warning when totalCount exceeds 10,000 — narrow filters first

pagination.description: Pagination metadata when results span multiple pages

policyNotice.description: Reasonable-use reminder when results are truncated or very large

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page

title: Find similar documents
